objective: Determine whether the complete 14,000-record acquisition corpus can support a compact top-32 causal teacher probability field and a matched-capacity decoder-only LayerCake execution plan without token mismatch, context overflow, hidden activations, copied source parameters, or final-material access.
causal_basis: V170 proved exact representation and routing but remained training-fit limited at 95.97% action accuracy and failed conditional generalization. V62, V70, V86, and V94 closed pooled representation, action-state, lexical-table, and gold-prefix state-alignment routes. A source-structure-matched causal decoder plus soft next-token probability field is untested: the hard target addresses exact fit while alternative probabilities and residual mass expose local teacher uncertainty and linguistic continuations absent from one sampled sequence.
standard_method: top-k logit knowledge distillation feasibility with an ABI-governed immutable probability-field artifact

probability_field.terminal_mapping: teacher token 32007 maps to host EOS action 2; all other teacher ids map to external id plus 4
probability_field.future_training_objective: hard gold NLL plus grouped top-32-and-residual-mass KL; weight fixed before any candidate run

decision_rule: Pass only if every authoritative output and host prompt round-trips exactly under the frozen native tokenizer, all 14 capabilities retain exactly 1,000 records, source/target/combined lengths fit the frozen host bounds, the top-32 probability field fits below 128 MiB, and the tied decoder plan contains 12.0M to 14,407,080 parameters. A pass authorizes only a separate LayerCake construct protocol and a separate GPU extraction protocol; it does not authorize training.
claim_boundary: No-model feasibility and accounting only. No extraction, candidate, quality, LayerCake performance, Phase 3 certification, final access, or ABI superiority claim.
